scope: Only the six frozen caster triangles, addressed texels, lookup q and saved physical blocker records. No mesh/source import/build, new ray, GPU, new selection, bias cap or coefficient change.
algorithm: Project existing caster vertices to saved light UV and q; bounds1=max(existingStored, minTriangleVertexQ-0.001). Clip triangle against the four addressed-texel planes with Sutherland-Hodgman, interpolating q on every crossing; exact affine minimum on resulting convex polygon is min(vertexQ)-0.001.
classification: Unchanged inclusive qLookup>=stored. Keep existing coverage fade. Physical blocker presence is read from saved records, not recalculated by rays.
predeclaredPredictions: bounds1 cannot lower stored q, so binary visibility cannot increase
intersection minimum is at least both full-triangle minimum and whole-texel affine minimum, within declared Float64 consistency tolerance
if full-triangle clamp or clipped minimum leaves a control lit, explicitly report it rather than select new points or tune a coefficient
polygon minimum is exact for the saved affine winning triangle restricted to one addressed square, not exact physical visibility of a multi-face texel
precision: Float64 geometry from saved Float32 vertex coordinates; no GPU raster/float32 parity claim
failurePolicy: One calculation only; no automatic retry or added cases. Preserve launcher failures before exec and any numerical failure. No GPU clipping proposal from this analysis.
